usageNotes: Use this to audit all auto-install tokens configured in Proxmox Datacenter Manager, including their enabled state, expiration, and who created them. Requires the System.Audit privilege on the system/auto-installation ACL path. Check the 'enabled' and 'expire-at' fields to identify stale or expired tokens before issuing new ones.

examples.summary: List all auto-install tokens to review active and expired entries

tips: An 'expire-at' value of 0 means the token never expires — flag these during security audits.
Disabled tokens (enabled: false) remain listed but cannot authenticate installer requests.
Token secrets are not returned by this endpoint; the secret is only available at creation time.
